docs.title: Important Announcements
docs.text:
Version 2.0 is Live!

We have fully redesigned the system architecture. If you are upgrading from v1.x, please check out our Migration Guide.

Deprecation Notice

Legacy authentication methods via HTTP Header tokens will be retired on December 31. Please migrate to OAuth2 Bearer tokens.

docs.title: Code Example
docs.text:
Here is how simple it is to initialize the project via CLI:

# Clone the repository
git clone [https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/YOUR-REPO.git](https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/YOUR-REPO.git)

# Move into project directory and run setup
cd YOUR-REPO
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py --run

docs.title: About This Project
docs.text: This project provides automated tools and documentation built with MkDocs Material.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Instant Search: Find documentation topics quickly with client-side indexing.
  • Light / Dark Mode: Automatically syncs with your system settings.
  • Responsive Layout: Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
